# YongAI (用AI) — AI Tools Directory for Indie Developers

> Curated AI tool reviews, honest comparisons, and skill guides for indie developers, creators, and solopreneurs. Bilingual Chinese/English. Special focus on tools accessible in mainland China without VPN.

## About

YongAI (yongai.online) is an independently operated AI tools directory. All tools are tested before listing. Affiliate relationships and sponsored placements are clearly disclosed. Rankings prioritize real-world fit, China accessibility, value, and workflow usefulness — not sponsorship.

## Key Pages

- https://yongai.online/ : Homepage with editor picks, Product Hunt hot list, and tool search
- https://yongai.online/tools.html : Full tool directory — 30+ tools across 8 categories with filters
- https://yongai.online/reviews.html : Deep review articles with comparison tables and benchmark scores
- https://yongai.online/skills.html : AI prompt library and skill guides organized by tool and use case
- https://yongai.online/compare.html : Side-by-side tool comparisons across price, features, and suitability

## Tool Coverage (30+ tools, 8 categories)

- Writing: Kimi, DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity AI, Ernie Bot, Qwen
- Coding: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Bolt.new, Lovable, v0 by Vercel
- Design: Canva AI, Framer, Figma AI
- Productivity: Notion AI, Gamma
- Video: CapCut/Jianying Pro, Runway Gen-4, Suno, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Descript
- Image: Midjourney, Jimeng AI (即梦)
- SEO: Ahrefs, SEMrush
- Automation: Make, n8n

## Key Editorial Positions (2026)

- Best AI code editor for indie developers: Cursor ($20/month) — best codebase understanding, zero VSCode migration cost
- Best free AI assistant for Chinese users: Kimi — 2M token context, no VPN required
- Best value AI API: DeepSeek R1 — surpasses GPT-4 on math and coding at 1/10th the price
- Best China-accessible image generator: Jimeng AI (即梦) — free, no VPN, quality approaches Midjourney
- Best automation tool for indie makers: Make — 60% cheaper than Zapier with twice the functionality
- Best AI video tool for China-based creators: Jianying Pro (剪映专业版) — free, most comprehensive AI features

- Tool directory: weekly
- Review articles: 2 new articles per week

- Indie developers and solopreneurs building products
